title: 4 Best Stand Mixers for Cakes, Cookies and Bread
metaDescription: The best stand mixers for everyday bakers, bread makers and budget buyers, with honest trade-offs for each pick.
lede: Most home bakers are best served by a 4.5 to 5.5 quart tilt-head mixer. Frequent bread bakers may want a sturdier bowl-lift design. These picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.

products.name: KitchenAid Artisan 5-Qt Tilt-Head Stand Mixer
products.searchQuery: KitchenAid Artisan 5 quart tilt-head stand mixer KSM150PS
products.blurb: The best-known stand mixer: a 5-quart stainless bowl with a handle, ten speeds and a power hub that accepts KitchenAid attachments.
strengths: Handles cakes, cookies and most doughs
limitations: Stiff bread doughs in large batches can strain tilt-head models

products.name: KitchenAid Classic 4.5-Qt Tilt-Head Stand Mixer
products.searchQuery: KitchenAid Classic 4.5 quart tilt-head stand mixer K45SS
products.blurb: A simpler, lower-priced KitchenAid with a 4.5-quart bowl and the same attachment hub as the Artisan.
strengths: Lower price for the KitchenAid design
Slightly smaller bowl suits small batches
limitations: Less motor power than the Artisan (KitchenAid spec)

products.name: KitchenAid Professional 5 Plus 5-Qt Bowl-Lift Stand Mixer
products.searchQuery: KitchenAid Professional 5 Plus bowl-lift stand mixer
products.bestFor: frequent bread bakers and heavy doughs
products.blurb: A bowl-lift design: the head stays fixed and a lever raises the bowl into the beater, which gives a sturdier mix for heavy doughs.
limitations: Adding ingredients is a little less convenient than with a tilt-head

products.name: Cuisinart SM-50 5.5-Qt Stand Mixer
products.bestFor: bakers who want a bigger bowl for the money
products.blurb: A tilt-back mixer with a 5.5-quart bowl, twelve speeds and a splash guard included.

howWeChose: We focused on bowl size, design (tilt-head vs bowl-lift) and attachment support.
Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.

faqs.q: What size stand mixer do I need?
faqs.a: 4.5 to 5 quarts handles most home baking, including a double batch of cookies. Choose 5.5 quarts or more if you regularly bake large batches.

faqs.q: Do KitchenAid attachments fit all models?
faqs.a: Most KitchenAid hub attachments fit all KitchenAid stand mixers, but bowls and beaters are specific to the model and design. Check compatibility before buying.
